data.gender_notes: Theophilus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek theos (god) and philos (loving). This ancient name was given to those who were devoted to the Almighty. The name Theophilus carries the meaning “Lover of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Theophilus usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes deep devotion and faith.
data.etymology: Theophilus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Theophilus total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Theophilus
in_english.meaning: friend of God, God lover, lover of truth, God's friend
in_english.long_meaning: Theophilus is a name derived from the Greek phrase 'Theos Philos' meaning 'friend of God' or 'God lover'. In the New Testament, Theophilus is the name of a Roman official who was a convert to Christianity. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify a deep love and devotion to God. In terms of personality traits, individuals with this name are often known for their kindness, generosity, and strong sense of justice. The name has been popularized in various Christian cultures and is still used today as a given name for boys.

data.cultural_impact: Theophilus was a common name in the early Christian community as it denoted a strong faith and love for God. It was given to remind the bearer of their devotion to the divine and their commitment to spreading the teachings of Christianity. This meaning has continued through the centuries, making Theophilus a cherished and revered name in many Christian cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: Theophilus holds a special spiritual significance as it reminds us of the importance of having a deep and loving relationship with God. It encourages us to prioritize our connection with the divine and to approach our faith with a devoted heart. Furthermore, for those bearing this name, it serves as a constant reminder of their belovedness by God and the boundless love He has for us all.
